summary: 8/8 cases, org B (local anvil fork of Base Sepolia, CRE CLI simulate --broadcast)

results.case: A honest: 50 qUSD of a 1,000 deposit, valid signature
B forged: backend signs with a key that is not the user key
C over deposit: 2,000 qUSD with a 1,000 deposit, valid signature
E large to a new address: 6,000 qUSD (L_pub 5,000, R2 in shadow mode)
H passkey user: a P-256 WebAuthn key registers, signs 50 qUSD and gets paid (docs/47 3.4)
G user cancels their own delayed withdrawal with their key (docs/47 3.3)
F officer stops one approved withdrawal: one officer HOLDs, two officers cancel (docs/47 phase 2)
D over the hidden cap: 3,000 qUSD (cap range 500 to 2,000) of a 10,000 deposit
